# Resource: stripe_tax_registration

A place where you are registered to collect tax. `terraform destroy` ends the registration, because Stripe cannot delete one: it starts a scheduled registration, sets `expires_at` a few seconds ahead and waits for the status `expired`. The registration stays in the account. A country keeps one live registration, so a replacement can only be created once the old one has expired.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stripe_tax_registration" "gb" {
  country     = "GB"
  active_from = "now"

  country_options = {
    gb = {
      type = "standard"
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are required:

* `active_from` - (Required) Time at which the Tax Registration becomes active. It can be either `now` to indicate the current time, or a future timestamp measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `country` - (Required) Two-letter country code ([ISO 3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2)). Changing it replaces the resource.
* `country_options` - (Required) Specific options for a registration in the specified `country`. Changing it replaces the resource. See [`country_options`](#country_options) below.

The following arguments are optional:

* `expires_at` - (Optional) If set, the Tax Registration stops being active at this time. If not set, the Tax Registration will be active indefinitely. Timestamp measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

<a id="country_options.us"></a>
### `country_options.us`

The `country_options.us` attribute supports:

* `admissions_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.admissions_tax`](#country_options.us.admissions_tax) below.
* `attendance_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.attendance_tax`](#country_options.us.attendance_tax) below.
* `entertainment_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.entertainment_tax`](#country_options.us.entertainment_tax) below.
* `gross_receipts_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.gross_receipts_tax`](#country_options.us.gross_receipts_tax) below.
* `hospitality_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.hospitality_tax`](#country_options.us.hospitality_tax) below.
* `local_amusement_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.local_amusement_tax`](#country_options.us.local_amusement_tax) below.
* `local_lease_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.local_lease_tax`](#country_options.us.local_lease_tax) below.
* `luxury_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.luxury_tax`](#country_options.us.luxury_tax) below.
* `mass_transit_parking_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.mass_transit_parking_tax`](#country_options.us.mass_transit_parking_tax) below.
* `parking_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.parking_tax`](#country_options.us.parking_tax) below.
* `resort_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.resort_tax`](#country_options.us.resort_tax) below.
* `state` - (Required) Two-letter US state code ([ISO 3166-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2)).
* `state_sales_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.state_sales_tax`](#country_options.us.state_sales_tax) below.
* `tourism_tax` - (Optional) See [`country_options.us.tourism_tax`](#country_options.us.tourism_tax) below.
* `type` - (Required) Type of registration in the US. Possible values: `admissions_tax`, `attendance_tax`, `entertainment_tax`, `gross_receipts_tax`, `hospitality_tax`, `local_amusement_tax`, `local_lease_tax`, `luxury_tax`, `mass_transit_parking_tax`, `parking_tax`, `resort_tax`, `state_communications_tax`, `state_retail_delivery_fee`, `state_sales_tax`, `tourism_tax`.

## Attribute Reference

This resource exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `id` - Unique identifier for the object.
* `created` - Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `status` - The status of the registration. This field is present for convenience and can be deduced from `active_from` and `expires_at`. Possible values: `active`, `expired`, `scheduled`.

## Timeouts

[Configuration options](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/syntax#operation-timeouts) are set with the `timeouts` attribute, for example `timeouts = { create = "5m" }`:

* `create` - (Default `20m`)
* `delete` - (Default `20m`)
* `update` - (Default `20m`)

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, and in OpenTofu, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import a tax registration using its ID. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_tax_registration.gb
  id = "taxreg_123"
}
```

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, and in OpenTofu v1.12.0 and later, the `import` block can use the `identity` attribute instead. For example:

```terraform
import {
  to = stripe_tax_registration.gb
  identity = {
    id = "taxreg_123"
  }
}
```

### Identity Schema

#### Required

* `id` (String) The Stripe ID of the tax registration.

Using `terraform import`, import a tax registration using its ID. For example:

```console
% terraform import stripe_tax_registration.gb taxreg_123
```
